concepts.def: Rapid reading for general sense; eye moves across page to grasp topic and main ideas; useful for first pass.
Searching for specific information; eyes hunt keyword without reading every word; useful for fact retrieval.
Detailed examination of text; analyses word choice, structure, effect; required for analytical questions.
Drawing conclusion from textual evidence beyond what is stated; supported by quotation; key examiner skill.
Combining information from two texts; finding similarities/differences; AQA Paper 2 Question 2 requires this.
Point, Evidence, Explanation, Link; structures analytical response; ensures every quotation analysed.

Unit 1: Writing for Purpose and Audience and Reading to Access Non-fiction and Media Texts — a core area of GCSE English Language.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.
